title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Northwind Analytics is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join our growing data team. You will partner with product, finance and operations to turn data into decisions. 

What you'll do:
- Build analyses and models that answer key business questions
- Communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
- Own projects end to end

What we're looking for:
- Experience with Python
- Experience with SQL
- Experience with XGBoost
- Experience with A/B testing
- Experience with AWS
- Experience with MLOps
notes: Phone screen went well; technical round booked.

atsAnalysis.summary: Solid match for Senior Data Scientist: the resume covers Python, SQL, AWS; gaps are MLOps.
atsAnalysis.improvedSummary: Data scientist with 5 years of experience in Python, SQL, AWS, delivering measurable business impact through forecasting, experimentation and clear stakeholder communication.

suggestions.improved: Add a bullet describing hands-on work with MLOps, with a measurable result.
